title: Reject Windows drive-qualified paths in research exports
body:
## Summary

The package exporter and offline checker currently accept `C:/outside.txt` and `D:outside.txt`: both are legal POSIX repository paths, but Windows path joining can discard the extraction destination. A real temporary Git repository reproduces successful export and checking of these names.

- Reject Windows drive prefixes in declared inputs, committed inventory paths, archive members and receipt rows using an exporter-specific `ntpath.splitdrive` check. Rejection occurs before publishing an export.
- Keep the shared POSIX source-path policy and non-drive colon names unchanged. Add real Git/CLI regressions and document the platform-independent containment rule.

This fixes the export/check contract; it does not claim a Windows runtime replay or universally unsafe extraction. Extractor filters still apply. No frozen inputs, source hashes, mathematics or selected-frontier artifacts change.

Scope: a bounded `portable-replay` tooling correction. Builds on [Tekalign's deterministic exporter](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/commit/2a4a17457e21de2de684bd8ad19938e9aef2319f), retaining its attribution and transport-integrity scope. Live overlap search on 2026-10-18 covered 340 open PRs, 2,959 closed PRs and 2,453 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; the matching Windows-role adapter and archive-verification work concern different contracts. Canonical main remained `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90` before submission.

## Test plan

Tested locally on macOS with CPython 3.12.14 and Git 2.54.0 (Apple Git-157). Run from the repository root:

- [x] Existing exporter suite plus five new regression methods: **14 passed**.
  ```sh
  python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_export*.py' -v
  ```
- [x] Optimized mode, including the spawned CLI processes: **5 passed**.
  ```sh
  python3.12 -O -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_export_drive_paths.py' -v
  ```
- [x] Run the new tests against the base versions of both scripts in a temporary snapshot: **8 failing subcases**, while both non-drive colon controls pass. The real Git export cases print `PASS_RESEARCH_EXPORT` before the fix.
- [x] Handcrafted bundles exercise the actual offline CLI with an empty `PATH`, including absolute/relative drive members and receipt-only drive paths; checks leave archive bytes unchanged. Real Git fixtures confirm rejection creates neither the output archive nor leftover temporary exports. No archive is extracted onto the filesystem.
- [x] `git diff --check`

Prepared for roger-sato with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
